message: ラーメンとボイン

name: Synn
message: 「Do it right away! Definitely gonna win!」
Facing a mountain of notebooks and study materials, I rolled up my sleeves.
Today I'm studying from early morning! Time for the Cramming King to show his true worth!

name: Azel
message: 「Hii, wh-what is this!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!?」

name: Sasami
message: 「Cock-a-doodle-dooooo!」
So.
In front of me, across the table, sits Azel, perched neatly.

name: Synn
message: 「Not that it's bad you came, but... why?」

name: Azel
message: 「Study session. Ramen」

name: Paqy
message: 「She thinks you won't treat her to ramen unless she does study sessions with you until the test, man」

name: Azel
message: 「Am I wrong?」
Well, whatever. At least she's in the mood to study.

name: Synn
message: 「...Got it. Shall we start?」

name: Azel
message: 「You」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「You're quiet today」
Today → days that weren't today weren't quiet → but we always study quietly in the library → a day I studied with Azel somewhere other than the library → yesterday's study session right here.

name: Synn
message: 「Last time was lively because Lolotte and Nanaka were asking me all kinds of questions」

name: Azel
message: 「I see」
That's right.
Right now, it's just the two of us.
Azel intently copies her English textbook word for word into her notebook.
Apparently, writing things out by hand is the best way to memorize.
The soft scratching sound of her mechanical pencil gliding across the notebook echoes continuously.
Slender, pale fingers. A straight, upright back.
Azel, looking just like a pretty, expensive doll.

name: Azel
message: 「It's quiet.」
Even at the library, we didn't talk all that much.
Still, the library was spacious, other academy students were studying there too, and with Melilot around, I took the silence for granted.
Right now, though, it's just the two of us.
It didn't bother me before when Azel came to visit about the demons, and yet.

name: Azel
message: 「Should I try making conversation?」

name: Synn
message: 「This is a study session, so I wouldn't really recommend idle chatter.」

name: Azel
message: 「I see.」
Huh? Did Azel look a little disappointed just now?

name: Synn
message: 「Well, as long as it doesn't get in the way, it's probably fine, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「I see.」

name: Azel
message: 「It's not as if I particularly want to talk to you.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmph... I mean it.」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you like breasts?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Azel
message: 「Are you fond of women with well-developed breasts?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why are you asking that out of nowhere!?」
Azel had a dead-serious look on his face.

name: Azel
message: 「Biologically speaking, women with well-developed breasts possess a stronger power to attract the opposite sex, and are therefore more likely to leave offspring, giving them an advantage in the struggle for survival.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it works?」

name: Azel
message: 「It is. Consequently, it is rational for men to be fond of women with well-developed breasts.」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, I don't think I'd fall for someone based on that kind of standard alone.」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you like them or dislike them?」

name: Synn
message: 「...I don't dislike them.」

name: Azel
message: 「So you do like them.」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... why such a sudden question anyway?」

name: Azel
message: 「Takahashi and Lolotte said the exact same thing in two completely different places.」

name: Synn
message: 「Takahashi? Oh, Sacchin.」
Lolotte is just parroting a guidebook. Probably.

name: Azel
message: 「That is all.」

name: Synn
message: 「...I see.」
Hmm. Guess there wasn't any deeper meaning to it.

name: Azel
message: 「My breast development is poor. Ria Kujou's is very good. Nanaka Yuugiri and Misa Brigitta Christeles are average.」
How am I even supposed to respond to that!?

name: Azel
message: 「These are objective facts ascertained through observation.」
Please pick a topic that's a little easier to talk about, Azel.
And then, once studying was over...

name: Azel
message: 「Ramen!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's only instant, though.」
『Chinese 2000 Sichuan-Shanghai-Beijing-Style Ramen"--five cups for 100 yen in a bargain bin.
Since it's on the pricier side, once you toss in some chopped green onions, crack in a raw egg to mellow out the flavor, and serve it in a proper bowl, it turns out pretty good.

name: Azel
message: 「May I?」

name: Synn
message: 「This doesn't count as the ramen I promised to treat you to after tests are over, so eat up without worrying」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't have to hug the bowl like that, it's fine」

name: Synn
message: 「It's instant, so I doubt it compares to a five-star restaurant's, though」

name: Azel
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Synn
message: 「Glad to hear it」

name: Azel
message: 「Delicious! Delicious!」
Azel looks so happy.
I never thought she'd start showing me a face like this.

name: Azel
message: 「Hm? What are you looking at?」

name: Synn
message: 「You've got a noodle hanging from the corner of your lips」

name: Azel
message: 「T-Tell me sooner!」
Slurp, slurp, it disappears into her mouth.
Cute.

name: Azel
message: 「Are you not eating?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I'll eat, I'll eat」
Instant ramen gets soggy pretty fast, after all.

name: Azel
message: 「It tastes good when I eat with you」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so」
I bury my face in the bowl and eat my ramen.
There probably wasn't any deeper meaning behind what she just said...
Only the slurping sounds of eating ramen echo in the room.
It feels kind of awkward.
What am I even supposed to talk about at a time like this?
After drinking every last drop of soup, Azel took out her digital camera and
pointed it at me.

name: Synn
message: 「Getting my picture taken while I'm eating is a little」

name: Azel
message: 「You're interesting」
Azel leans in closer with a sudden motion.
She's close enough that I can almost feel her breath.

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so? I feel like I'm just making a normal face, though」

name: Azel
message: 「I just feel like taking pictures of you」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm literally just eating, though...」

name: Azel
message: 「Besides, the ramen you made for me is delicious」

name: Synn
message: 「I wouldn't really call it 'making' it...」
To hide my embarrassment, I shove my face into the bowl to drink the soup, hiding from the camera.
I gulp down the rest of the soup in one go, suddenly look up, and snatch the digital camera from Azel.

name: Azel
message: 「W-What are you doing」
I snap a candid shot of a flustered Azel!

name: Azel
message: 「S-Stop it! That's embarrassing」

name: Synn
message: 「Now we're even」
I hand the camera back.

name: Azel
message: 「You are the Student Council President. I am the chronicler. You are the one who gets photographed. I am the one who takes the photos」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, you two are doing something fun! Let me be in the picture too!」

name: Azel
message: 「No. I am the photographer. You are Student Council equipment」

name: Sally
message: 「I get it! I'm not a freebie, I'm equipment! Hehehe. Now I can talk back to Rolochi. I'm not a freebie, I'm equipment! Like that」

name: Azel
message: 「How foolish」

name: Synn
message: 「There's not much difference between a freebie and equipment」

name: Sally
message: 「Really? Aw, man」

name: Azel
message: 「What did you come here for? There's no ramen. Even if there were, I wouldn't give you any」

name: Sally
message: 「Oh, shoot, I forgot to tell you! Nanaka came by earlier, left some soba, and went home!」

name: Synn
message: 「What was she holding back for? She should have just come on in」

name: Azel
message: 「Probably because we were studying」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, wasn't that quite a while ago」

name: Sally
message: 「Yeah. Sure was」

name: Synn
message: 「The soba's gonna get soggy! Tell me things like that sooner」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't worry, Prez, I ate it before it got soggy. That's what I came here to report!」

name: Synn
message: 「What did you say!?」

name: Azel
message: 「The ramen you made tastes better」

name: Synn
message: 「No, there's no way that's true」

name: Ardin
message: 「Where are you!?」

name: Ardin
message: 「Where are you hiding, Student Council!」

name: Ardin
message: 「Grr, even though you run around scared of the mighty me, you relentlessly bully poor little Pasta behind my back! You cowards!」

name: Ardin
message: 「I will win! I am justice! Uooooooooh!」
